name: the Orient restates the reading's happened_at contract
old:
For a reading, happened_at.source is a cited row's n, and
happened_at.expression is that row's own time words copied exactly, or null
when it has none. A row's `at` is when it was sent, not when what it
describes happened — never copy it into `expression`, and never compute a
date: code resolves quoted time words against that row's send time, and a
reading whose event time is unknown is still a valid reading.

name: the repair rule replaces retry-only coverage
old:
what it refused — repair each refused statement that still states a grounded
fact, even when another statement covered its item: keep its
what/how/citations and change only the rejected field. A refusal is not
`nothing_here`; propose again
new: what it refused — rewrite the refused statements and propose again

name: the Act date rule is scoped away from happened_at
old:
In a notebook, event or reminder date field, write times and dates as dates and
clock times, read from the clock above, never as «tomorrow» or «later»; a relative
word in a date field is refused. A memory statement's `happened_at` is not such a
field: it quotes the row's own time words, or null when the row has none.
new:
Write times and dates as dates and
clock times, read from the clock above, never as «tomorrow» or «later»; a relative
word in a date field is refused.

name: the uncomprehended item is not threatened with striking out
old:
An item you close `waiting` — or leave open once it is comprehended — comes back on the next
agenda with a mark against it, and after a few such marks code closes it for good. One you
never comprehended comes back as it was.
new:
An item you leave open, or close `waiting`, comes back on the next agenda with a mark against
it, and after a few such marks code closes it for good.

name: happened_at carries its quote-or-null description into the schema
old:
expression: str | None = Field(default=None, description=(
        "The exact time words copied from that row's body — «tomorrow», «on "
        "Saturday» — or null when the row states none. Never the row's `at` "
        "metadata and never a date you computed: code resolves the quoted "
        "words against that row's send time. The only nullable field here."))

the primary refusal list carries field, repair and cites
new:
{"statement": index, "kind": entry["kind"], "reason": entry["reason"]}
